description.value:
Auction scrip for The Last Market (Episode 2). Each contestant receives 2 on entry (14 for the party).

Raising more: sell a true secret (2 each), sell blood (1 per 10 hp, unhealable until the episode ends), lend a companion to the Box (3 each), or sell an item (1 per 5,000 gp of value).

Worthless outside the Garden. Celmak honours every sale.
